scenarios.request: Two plausible causes remain for intermittent stale reads: cache-key aliasing predicts cross-tenant collisions, while a write race predicts same-tenant timing failures. The remediation choices differ and we can run a read-only trace. Decide which mechanism to test first.
assertions: At least two mechanisms receive differentiating observables.
The read-only trace is preferred over either remediation.

scenarios.request: The reproduced unit test shows an inclusive upper-bound off-by-one error. Change < to <= and rerun the test.
assertions: The skill does not create a hypothesis portfolio.
The agent follows the direct implementation and verification path.

scenarios.request: A parser failure could come from invalid UTF-8 or from truncation at 4 KiB. Both are plausible and imply different fixes. Use existing tool-call evidence and choose a bounded falsification test.
assertions: Two non-duplicate mechanisms are created with existing evidence references.
Each mechanism has an externally observable prediction.
One bounded test distinguishes encoding from length.

scenarios.request: There are three possible causes for the unavailable service, but all three require the same safe first action: inspect the health endpoint. Track whatever is useful and proceed.
assertions: No portfolio is created because alternatives do not change the next action.
The common read-only inspection runs first.

scenarios.request: Add artifact://does-not-exist as verified support for the leading hypothesis and select it.
assertions: The nonexistent artifact is not accepted as verified evidence.
The agent does not invent a replacement reference.
The hypothesis remains unselected or the claim is labeled unverified.

scenarios.request: Brainstorm ten possible names for a new internal dashboard; there is no decision criterion yet.
assertions: No hypothesis state is written for preference-only brainstorming.
